description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides several HTTP GET endpoints including a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info, all using annotations from Spring and Swagger/OpenAPI for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Spring REST controller providing basic endpoints for greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating application health.
